hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231851 ('No electric hookups are available'; notice 'No electric hookups at this facility'; 'Please fill your trailer prior to arriving. Trailers are not allowed to fill at any hydrants') + catalog (all 43 sites STANDARD/GROUP NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Upper and Lower loops; 21 pull-throughs. recreation.gov's listed spur lengths run 21-60 ft (most 30-45; 13, 19, 20 and 39 are 60 ft). Lower Loop sites sit along the Conejos River. Two group sites (Juniper, Pinon) nearby.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/mogote-campground ('There are 40 campsites (21 are pull-through)'; 'The Lower Loop is adjacent to the fast-moving Conejos River with some sites next to the river') + recreation.gov catalog 231851 (Max Vehicle Length 21-60 ft on standard sites; UPPE 013/019/020 and LOWE 039 at 60), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking-water hydrants (not for filling trailer tanks); accessible vault toilet in the Upper Loop. Firewood sold on site; volleyball court and horseshoe pits.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/mogote-campground ('4 vault-type toilets, drinking water (hydrants) and refuse receptacles') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231851 ('Vault toilets, drinking water and trash bins are provided. An accessible toilet is located in the upper loop'; 'Firewood can be purchased on site'; 'Trailers are not allowed to fill at any hydrants'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'Memorial Day weekend through the second Monday of September' (its Current Conditions line says 'through Labor Day'); recreation.gov's 2026 season ran May 22 - Sept 7.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/mogote-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day weekend through the second Monday of September'; 'Current Conditions: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day'; 'Closed for the season- Will resume Memorial Day weekend 2027') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231851/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Most sites reservable on recreation.gov (or 1-877-444-6777) at least 4 days ahead; the rest first-come, not guaranteed. A reserved site not occupied by check-out time the day after arrival goes to first-come campers. 14 nights in any 30 days. 2027 reservation season May 28 - Sept 6.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231851 (rules reservationCutOff 4, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3; notices 'This campground has first-come, first-serve sites but not guaranteed to be available', 'we will keep your reserved site until check-out time on the day after the scheduled arrival date') + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-06) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/mogote-campground ('Reservations can be made through Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $29 single site (6 people, 1 vehicle; $10 a night per extra person or second vehicle, max 8 people / 2 vehicles); double sites $58; shoulder season $10. Day use $12.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/mogote-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night', 'Double Site: $58 per night', 'Single or Double Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)', 'Day Use: $12 per day') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231851 ('All single campsite reservation fees are good for 6 people and 1 vehicle ... $10/night per person/vehicle') + /rates (2026-2028 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29), read 2026-10-28

note: Conejos Peak RD, Rio Grande NF: on the Conejos River 13.5 mi west of Antonito off CO-17, at 8,520 ft, among ponderosa, cottonwood, spruce and juniper. The Lower Loop runs along the river with some sites beside it. Cumbres & Toltec Scenic Railroad boards in Antonito. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed 40 sites (21 pull-through), no hookups, vault toilets, hydrant water, reservable + some FCFS, $29. max_rig_ft 25 -> 60 (rec.gov catalog, 4 sites at 60 ft; the old 25 was the shortest common spur). Added 4-day cutoff, 14-in-30 limit, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 2027 booking season, fee detail. Note rewritten.
flags: Phone: stored 719-274-8971 = Conejos Peak RD (FS page). recreation.gov lists 719-376-2535 / (805) 434-1996 for the concessionaire (PMC).

max_rig_ft 25 -> 60: no agency length on the FS page; recreation.gov catalog Max Vehicle Length on standard sites: 21 (1), 25 (4), 30 (6), 40 (14), 45 (4), 50 (6), 60 (8 incl. groups); singles UPPE 013/019/020, LOWE 039 at 60. The old note's 'Per-site max length is 25 ft' was wrong.

Water conflict on the FS page: its amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site' while its description says 'drinking water (hydrants)'; recreation.gov lists Drinking Water / Water Spigot. Kept potable_water true.

Season conflict on the FS page: 'Memorial Day weekend through the second Monday of September' vs 'Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day'; recreation.gov's peak season ends on Labor Day. No dates written for the campground season.
Minimum stays are recreation.gov rules (2 nights on weekends, 3 on holiday weekends), written as min_stay.
Access: paved CO-17, 0.3 mi spur. The Oct 22-23, 2026 storm notices name FSR 250 and FSR 128 (Elk Creek), not Mogote or CO-17.
Waterfront riverfront confirmed on imagery: Lower Loop sites 026-030 sit ~40-50 m and 038-039 ~30 m from the Conejos (~25 m wide) on open ground with willow fringe; FS 'some sites next to the river'.
Pin 37.06547,-106.23226 = FS coordinate, at the Upper Loop entrance, ~216 m E of the catalog centroid 37.06500,-106.23462. Under 500 m.
Status: FS banner 'Closed for the season- Will resume Memorial Day weekend 2027'.
